items.description:
Last published: 2024 Authors: ****
A foundational and practical guide for effectively learning the fundamental blockchain concepts and progressively building a blockchain from scratch in Go with gRPC. An interesting and challenging adventure that takes you from the foundational concepts and purpose through the technical design and implementation to the practical testing and usage of the proposed blockchain. Simple, yet non-trivial. Concise, yet detailed. Practical, yet well-grounded.
items.title: Practical guide for building a blockchain from scratch in Go with gRPC Free

items.description:
Last published: 2021 Authors: ****
This book was written to teach how to develop web applications in Go for people who know a bit of Go and have basic information about web applications in general. We (you) will build a webapp without using a third party framework and using as few external libraries as possible. The advantage is that you'll learn a lot when you code without a framework.
items.title: Webapps in Go the anti textbook Free
